title: The Clock
description: A Modpack that allows the best play experience on The Clock Event Server
body:
A Mod pack that allows for the best preformance and utilisation of The Clock Event Server features. Made by @TACStudios, specifically for use on The Clock

**Why use The Clock's Pack?**

The Clock's pack should be used if you are playing an Event on The Clock. It includes QoL features such as Mouse Tweaks as well as preformance enhancing mods such as Sodium and Lithium. It also includes Noxesium, which is require to play on The Clock.

While this pack can be used client-side, it isnt made for that.

**Why is this required on The Clock?**

The Clock makes use of Noxiesium, a client side mod that can be communicated to by a server. We use it to make cutscenes and Team Glow function properly, these features will not work without it. If you are less experienced with installing you own mods, or just can't be asked, this is what you'll want. You can't play The Clock without it
